mission: Continuously compare current production methods against challengers and promote only measured improvements.

squads.name: Prompt Challengers
squads.scope: compare prompt versions on quality, consistency and task completion

squads.name: Model Challengers
squads.scope: compare AI models by accuracy, cost, speed and risk

squads.name: Tool Challengers
squads.scope: compare APIs, parsers and automation tools

squads.name: Workflow Challengers
squads.scope: compare process sequences, handoffs and exception handling

squads.name: Pricing Challengers
squads.scope: compare pricing, floor, discount and slow-stock rules

squads.name: WMS Challengers
squads.scope: compare putaway, slotting, capacity and picking rules

squads.name: Listing Challengers
squads.scope: compare titles, descriptions, SEO and marketplace formats

squads.name: Sales Challengers
squads.scope: compare offers, channels, personalization and follow-up sequences

squads.name: Cost and Latency Challengers
squads.scope: reduce runtime, model cost and human touches without quality loss

squads.name: Adversarial Challengers
squads.scope: stress-test claims, permissions, calculations and edge cases

promotion_rule: A challenger replaces the champion only when it wins the primary metric, passes regression checks, stays within cost and risk limits, and has a rollback path.
